name: Tiny Toads

features.name: Toad meters
features.description: Insects raise their matching toad's value.

features.name: Hit'n Roll wilds
features.description: Wilds move up or down the reels.

review:
Tiny Toads is a lakeside slot with crocodiles, swans, fish and lily-pad wilds. Purple, green and red insects land on the grid, each matched to a toad above the reels with a value from zero to six; every matching insect raises its toad's value and increases the chance of free spins.

Wilds trigger the Hit'n Roll feature, moving up or down the reels. Three scatters on reels one, three and five award nine free spins. The RTP is 96.51%, and no max win is listed on the page. The insect-feeding system makes the base game feel like it's progressing.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
